unit_id_source: Unit ids and display names from data/factions/<faction>/faction.json on branch cursor/web-playtest (internal/web-playtest.bundle, commit 947b910). Lines are storefront-safe; no street-drug names.

encoding.music: Ogg Vorbis 96 kbps stereo 48000 Hz, loop tracks crossfaded tail-into-head (4 s equal-power); stings faded out
encoding.barks: Ogg Vorbis 64 kbps mono 24000 Hz, peak -1 dBFS, dry (radio band-pass is applied in Godot per blueprint: 400-3400 Hz + light distortion)

menu.title: Shattered Monsoon (Mekong March)
menu.prompt: Epic RTS main menu theme, Red Alert 3 Soviet March energy. Heavy chugging industrial electric guitars, booming brass horns, wordless militant choir chanting in unison, Burmese Hsaing Waing tuned drum circle percussion and bronze gongs. Southeast Asian modern-military RTS soundtrack in the spirit of Command & Conquer Red Alert 3, instrumental only, no vocals with words, mixed for game background, steady groove, seamless loop. 132 BPM.

gtfc.title: Burma Road Grind

Drop-D distorted rhythm guitars, double-kick drums, clanging mining machinery percussion, fierce Burmese Hne double-reed melodies, low brass stabs. Southeast Asian modern-military RTS soundtrack in the spirit of Command & Conquer Red Alert 3, instrumental only, no vocals with words, mixed for game background, steady groove, seamless loop. 138 BPM.

Southeast Asian modern-military RTS soundtrack in the spirit of Command & Conquer Red Alert 3, instrumental only, no vocals with words, mixed for game background, steady groove, seamless loop. 145 BPM.

Southeast Asian modern-military RTS soundtrack in the spirit of Command & Conquer Red Alert 3, instrumental only, no vocals with words, mixed for game background, steady groove, seamless loop. 130 BPM.

accent_policy.rule: Asian accents only. Clips heard as Eastern European, Russian, Western European are deleted (removed). English takes not heard as one of Burmese, Chinese, Malaysian, Singaporean, Thai, Vietnamese carry accent_fail: true and the game should skip them.

barks.retired: The first English set (520 clips, 41 of 143 audited clips heard as European) is in _retired/barks_v1/ and must not ship.

line_changes.all units: ability and under_attack events added (2 lines each)
line_changes.militia_ability_1: now "Firebomb, catch!" (the "Molotov" take was heard as Russian)

music_policy: Keep the 7 Lyria tracks and media/music-sample.ogg; the user adds their own MP3s alongside. Run gen_audio.py only with --only barks.
announcer: Announcer lines have their own manifest at announcer/manifest.json (announcer/<lang>/<faction>/<key>.ogg). The first English announcer set is in _retired/announcer_v1/ and must not ship.
status: Complete: 7 music tracks; barks and announcer in en (Asian-accented), my, zh, th, ms via tools/gen_voices.py (supersedes gen_audio.py --only barks). See barks/manifest.json and announcer/manifest.json for coverage, accent_fail and fallback flags.

dialogue.accent_policy: same as barks: see dialogue/manifest.json accent_policy
